def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Fix species label variants (typos)
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})

    # Fix island label variants (case)
    island_map = {'biscoe': 'Biscoe', 'Biscoe': 'Biscoe', 'Dream': 'Dream',
                  'Torgersen': 'Torgersen'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().map(lambda v: island_map.get(v, v))

    # body_mass_g: text with commas/spaces -> numeric
    s = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.replace(' ', '', regex=False)
    num = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

    # Unit error: values like 3650000 (mg) -> 3650 g when dividing by 1000 lands in valid range
    bad = (num > 6500) & (num / 1000 >= 2500) & (num / 1000 <= 6500)
    num = num.mask(bad, num / 1000)

    # Anything still out of the plausible range -> treat as missing
    num = num.where((num >= 2500) & (num <= 6500))
    df['body_mass_g'] = num

    # Sex must be one of male/female; unknown stays missing and is dropped for grouping
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    return df


def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
